title: Separate P&L Table, Greeks and Payoff Table views instead of one table (G-18-1)
reference_behaviour: P&L Table lists per-leg target P&L, target price, entry price and LTP with a Total row; the Greeks tab lists per-leg Delta, Theta, Decay, Gamma, Vega with a Total; the Payoff Table lists underlying targets against P&L on target date and expiry.
ours: SPEC CHANGE: REQ-035 AC-1 'There is exactly one table (not two) per strategy' (ADR-008). Copying splits the single table into three tabbed views. For the owner's batch.
